source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

python3 << 'PYEOF'
import numpy as np

np.random.seed(42)

# 新 clean baseline (V2 re-eval)
clean_lz = np.array([0.8446, -1.8765, 0.3452, 0.0206, 1.7323, 2.8466, -0.4007, 1.1656, 0.1897, -2.2497])

# Contam lz* values (seed=999 pipeline)
contam_values = {
    '15%': -2.992,
    '25%': -2.805,
    '50%': -3.331
}

n_bootstrap = 10000

print("=== Llama Bootstrap CIs (percentile method, 10000 resamples) ===")
print(f"Clean baseline: mean={clean_lz.mean():.4f}, SD={clean_lz.std(ddof=1):.4f}, n={len(clean_lz)}")
print()

for level, contam_lz in contam_values.items():
    d_point = (contam_lz - clean_lz.mean()) / clean_lz.std(ddof=1)
    
    d_boot = np.zeros(n_bootstrap)
    for i in range(n_bootstrap):
        boot_sample = np.random.choice(clean_lz, size=len(clean_lz), replace=True)
        boot_mean = boot_sample.mean()
        boot_sd = boot_sample.std(ddof=1)
        if boot_sd > 0:
            d_boot[i] = (contam_lz - boot_mean) / boot_sd
        else:
            d_boot[i] = np.nan
    
    d_boot = d_boot[~np.isnan(d_boot)]
    ci_lower = np.percentile(d_boot, 2.5)
    ci_upper = np.percentile(d_boot, 97.5)
    
    print(f"contam_{level}: lz*={contam_lz:.3f}")
    print(f"  d = {d_point:.2f} [{ci_lower:.1f}, {ci_upper:.1f}]")
    print(f"  |d| = {abs(d_point):.2f} [{abs(ci_upper):.1f}, {abs(ci_lower):.1f}]")
    print()

print("=== For Table 3 (Detection-Diagnosis) ===")
for level in ['15%', '50%']:
    contam_lz = contam_values[level]
    d_point = (contam_lz - clean_lz.mean()) / clean_lz.std(ddof=1)
    
    d_boot = np.zeros(n_bootstrap)
    for i in range(n_bootstrap):
        boot_sample = np.random.choice(clean_lz, size=len(clean_lz), replace=True)
        boot_mean = boot_sample.mean()
        boot_sd = boot_sample.std(ddof=1)
        if boot_sd > 0:
            d_boot[i] = (contam_lz - boot_mean) / boot_sd
        else:
            d_boot[i] = np.nan
    
    d_boot = d_boot[~np.isnan(d_boot)]
    ci_lower = np.percentile(d_boot, 2.5)
    ci_upper = np.percentile(d_boot, 97.5)
    
    print(f"contam_{level}: |d| = {abs(d_point):.2f} [{abs(ci_upper):.1f}, {abs(ci_lower):.1f}]")

print()
print("=== SUMMARY FOR LATEX ===")
for level, contam_lz in contam_values.items():
    d_point = (contam_lz - clean_lz.mean()) / clean_lz.std(ddof=1)
    d_boot = np.zeros(n_bootstrap)
    for i in range(n_bootstrap):
        boot_sample = np.random.choice(clean_lz, size=len(clean_lz), replace=True)
        boot_mean = boot_sample.mean()
        boot_sd = boot_sample.std(ddof=1)
        if boot_sd > 0:
            d_boot[i] = (contam_lz - boot_mean) / boot_sd
        else:
            d_boot[i] = np.nan
    d_boot = d_boot[~np.isnan(d_boot)]
    ci_lo = np.percentile(d_boot, 2.5)
    ci_hi = np.percentile(d_boot, 97.5)
    print(f"{level}: $-{abs(d_point):.2f}$ [${ci_lo:.1f}$, ${ci_hi:.1f}$]")
PYEOF
